source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 676 fixes a leak by clearing threadTree.selectedIndex after its feed display helper. Current code places the clear in each selectWebsite/selectSummary/selectFolder task before registered cleanup removes the RSS account. The menu-bar path is still skipped on macOS because the test cannot click the native menu bar. This is a test lifetime boundary, not a product change to RSS display or evidence of a general account leak. No leak checker, native menu test or browser test was run.
title: Clear the displayed feed message before removing its test account
